plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 332-333 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA in Sociology. SOC 120 requires SOC 1 (sequenced in Fall Y1). SOC 2 and SOC 3 have no prerequisites. 'Major Elective' maps to major; 'Major Elective & GE' maps to major. LIS 74 is listed as 3 units in this sequence. Computed total 60. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
